items.heading: Level 10 Starts At Rs
items.text: Level 10 starts at Rs 56,100 basic pay in the 7th Pay Commission matrix. The Union Cabinet raised central DA from 60% to 63% of basic pay from 1 July 2026, announced on 28 October 2026.
